title: Elijah Prays for the Little Boy
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler who is brave when things feel too big, and tonight Elijah carries a sick boy upstairs and prays with all his heart: Beau feels scared when his baby sister is sick, and bravely kneels to ask Heavenly Father for help.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because Beau is brave when things feel too big, and Elijah did not run from the widow’s sorrow. He carried her boy upstairs and prayed with all his heart. In Beau’s world today: Beau’s baby sister has a high fever, and Mom looks worried. Beau feels scared inside. He goes to his room, folds his arms, and asks Heavenly Father to help her. Then he brings his sister her soft blanket. Just like Elijah, Beau learned that when something feels too big, he can pray.
